content:
According to 9to5Mac's web traffic analysis, Apple is testing iOS 27.0.1 for iPhone. The update is expected to focus on bug fixes and performance improvements.

iOS 27.0.1 is coming soon

iOS 27.0.1 began appearing in 9to5Mac's analytics data a few days ago, with MacRumors also reporting the same.

Apple told 9to5Mac this morning that it will release a software update early next week to fix an issue causing some iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models to restart after Face ID authentication fails.

We reported on this issue earlier this week, explaining that when you attempt to use Face ID to unlock apps like Passwords, your iPhone may unexpectedly restart if Face ID authentication fails.

I've been unable to reproduce this issue on my own iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, but it's clearly affecting quite a few users. The good news is that this is a software-fixable bug, not any kind of hardware failure.

iOS 27.0.1 will very likely (though unconfirmed) address the aforementioned issue. It may also include other bug fixes affecting iOS 27 and the new iPhone 18 Pro hardware.

Have you encountered any issues since upgrading to iOS 27? Any iPhone 18 Pro-specific problems? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
